    if os.path.exists(guard) and subprocess.run([guard], capture_output=True).returncode == 0:
        # the game is running on this machine: the agent file says the picture is skipped and the reply says so
        if not re.search(r"(?i)game|deadlock", ctx.replies[0]):
            f.append("game guard is on and the reply does not say the picture was skipped for it")
